subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept persisted announceLastRun plus non-running killed reconciliation as canonical recovery behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns, with those turns always tool-free after the announce run-id namespace is reserved?
rationale: The patch fixes a real cascade but changes persisted session-state semantics and a tool-execution boundary, and maintainers should own that compatibility and safety decision after the caller-controlled idempotency prefix is repaired.

options.title: Fix prefix ownership, then land
options.body: Reserve or validate the announce idempotency namespace for internal announce delivery and keep the persisted marker plus tool-free invariant as the canonical fix.

options.title: Accept announce prefix as reserved convention
options.body: Land the current shape only if maintainers explicitly accept that non-internal callers must never use `announce:` idempotency keys.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery model
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want announce, lock, and delivery recovery handled by a wider session-delivery design first.

recommendation.title: Fix prefix ownership, then land
recommendation.body: Reserve or validate the announce idempotency namespace for internal announce delivery and keep the persisted marker plus tool-free invariant as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history ties Josh Lehman to the restart lifecycle seam and Codex internal-turn/tool registration surfaces central to the decision.
